narrative.intro: Fisher Sand and Gravel obligated $13.4B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Fisher Sand and Gravel received 15 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $890M. Fisher Sand and Gravel saw obligations up 1338.2% year over year. Fisher Sand and Gravel posted most of its federal activity in FY26, with earlier histories including $928M in FY25, $121M in FY24, and $259M in FY23. Fisher Sand and Gravel had no recorded obligations in FY21 and FY22. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date), and the page note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Fisher Sand and Gravel shows a sharp concentration of federal spending in the current fiscal year compared with prior years. Fisher Sand and Gravel’s large average award size and the jump in obligations indicate that a few very large awards are driving the FY26 total. Fisher Sand and Gravel’s contractors and program managers should account for concentration risk and contract management bandwidth given the award size profile.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Fisher Sand and Gravel's federal obligations?
sections.body: Fisher Sand and Gravel obligated $13.4B in FY26 while the prior full fiscal years show much smaller totals: $928M in FY25, $121M in FY24, and $259M in FY23. Fisher Sand and Gravel received 15 awards in FY26, and the average award size in FY26 is $890M, which implies that a small number of large awards account for most obligations. Fisher Sand and Gravel had no recorded obligations in FY21 and FY22, so the FY26 total represents a major concentration compared with earlier years.
